error.load: Could not load the wishlists. Check your connection.
priority.question: How much do you want this?
mine.emptyText: Add what you wish for, by hand or with an Amazon link. Everyone else can see your list.
mine.note: You will not see here whether or by whom something is being given to you, so the surprise stays. A wish stays until you delete it.
others.subtitle: Everyone else's wishlists
others.emptyText: As soon as someone adds a wish, their list appears here.
person.nothing: Nothing on the list right now
shopping.emptyText: When you choose “I'll give this” on someone's list, the wish lands here until you tick it off as bought.
toast.alreadyTaken: Someone else is already giving this.
toast.reserveFailed: Could not reserve it. Please try again.
share.title: My wishlist on MiniNode
editor.urlHint: Paste an Amazon link: the title and link are filled in for you.
editor.title: What do you wish for?
editor.noteHint: For example size, colour or “second-hand is fine”.
editor.imageHint: On Amazon: right-click the product picture and choose “Copy image address”.
editor.amazonTitle: Amazon item recognised and title filled in. Check it quickly and add the price.
editor.amazonNoTitle: Amazon item recognised. Please enter a title.
editor.errUrl: Enter a complete link that starts with https://.
editor.errPrice: Enter the price as a number, e.g. 24.99.
editor.errImage: The picture address must start with https://.
editor.errSave: Could not save. Please try again.
editor.photoChoose: Choose a photo from the gallery or camera
editor.photoHint: From the gallery or the camera. It is saved shrunk and everyone who sees your list can see it.
editor.errPhoto: The picture could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
editor.errUpload: The photo could not be uploaded. Please try again.

toast.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be created.
bd.suiteDenied: Birthdays of your Aether Notes contacts need the admin's approval. Until then you see the other birthdays.
bd.emptyText: Add a person, or enter birthdays in Aether Notes and in "Your account". Then you see here when a present is due.
bd.noIdeas: No idea yet. Note what could fit.
bd.errDate: That date does not exist. Please check day and month.
bd.errYear: Enter a year between 1900 and today, or leave it empty.
bd.defaultRemindHint: At 9:00, as a notification on your devices. Can be changed per person.
bd.accountHint: Your own birthday is under "Your account" in the portal. There you decide whether others see it.
bd.pushNoIdea: In {days} days. No gift idea yet.
bd.noContacts: Birthdays of your contacts appear here once Aether Notes publishes them. The admin has to approve reading the calendar entries.
